Faq_Q1_Title: Why isn't the game detecting my mods?
Faq_Q1_Answer1: Make sure your mods are in the Active load order on the Home page. Only mods listed in the Load Order panel are passed to the game at launch.
Faq_Q1_Answer2: Verify that your game installation path is set correctly under Settings → Game Config. Use the Re-detect button if you're unsure.
Faq_Q1_Hint: Tip: If mods were downloaded from the internet, Windows may block their DLLs. Go to Settings → Tools → Unblock DLLs to fix this.
Faq_Q2_Answer1: When you download files from the internet, Windows adds a hidden security marker (Zone.Identifier) to them. This can prevent Bannerlord from loading mod DLLs.
Faq_Q2_Answer2: The Unblock DLLs tool in Settings → Tools removes this marker from all DLL files in your Modules folder. CalradiaForge also does this automatically when you install mods through the app.
Faq_Q3_Title: I'm getting errors when installing mods from an archive.
Faq_Q3_Answer1: CalradiaForge extracts mod archives directly into the Bannerlord Modules folder. Make sure the archive contains a valid mod structure with a SubModule.xml file.
Faq_Q3_Answer2: If the archive is nested (a folder inside a folder), CalradiaForge will attempt to detect the correct root. If extraction still fails, try extracting the mod manually.
Faq_Q4_Answer1: A modpack is a saved snapshot of your active mods and their load order. You can create multiple modpacks for different playstyles (e.g., Vanilla+, Overhaul, Hardcore).
Faq_Q4_Answer2: Switch between modpacks using the dropdown on the Home page. The selected modpack's load order is applied immediately.
Faq_Q4_Answer3: To save changes to a modpack, go to the Mod Packs page and click 'Save to Modpack'. This overwrites the saved data with your current active load order.
Faq_Q4_Hint: Select the correct modpack on the Home page before changing its load order. Then save the changes from the Mod Packs page, or the changes will be lost.
Faq_Q5_Title: Why can't I launch the game from CalradiaForge on Epic or GamePass?
Faq_Q5_Answer1: TaleWorlds requires authentication through the Epic or Xbox client. This is a platform-level restriction that third-party launchers cannot bypass.
Faq_Q5_Answer2: CalradiaForge still provides full mod management, load order arrangement, and modpack features for these platforms; use the platform's own launcher to start the game.
Faq_Q5_Hint: Direct launch support for Epic and GamePass is planned for a future release. For now, load orders are not passed to the game's native launcher.
Faq_Q6_Title: Can I import presets from Novus Launcher?
Faq_Q6_Answer1: Yes. Go to the Mod Packs page and click Import. Select a Novus Launcher preset file (.xml) and CalradiaForge will convert it into a CalradiaForge modpack automatically.
Faq_Q6_Answer2: You can also import native CalradiaForge modpack files (.json) the same way.
Faq_Q6_Answer3: You can also place CalradiaForge modpack files directly in the modpacks subdirectory of the app directory. The app will automatically refresh the available modpacks.
Faq_Q6_Hint: Refresh the page or switch pages to update the dropdown menus automatically.
Faq_Q7_Title: When should I clear the mod cache?
Faq_Q7_Answer1: Clear the mod cache if you've manually added or removed mods from the Modules folder outside of CalradiaForge, or if the mod list appears stale or incorrect.
Faq_Q7_Answer2: Go to Settings → Tools → Clear Mod Cache. On next launch, CalradiaForge will rescan the Modules folder and rebuild the cache.
Faq_Q8_Title: How do I report a bug or request a feature?
Faq_Q8_Answer1: Open an issue on the CalradiaForge GitHub repository. Include a short description of the problem, steps to reproduce it, and any relevant log output.
Faq_Q8_OpenIssuesHint: Opens the CalradiaForge Issues page on GitHub in your browser.
Faq_Q8_Hint: Tip: Enable Debug Mode in Settings → General before reproducing the issue. This gives more detailed logs for troubleshooting.
